what_happened: The job added a shared helper in athena-testutil for writing stand-in scripts without hitting ETXTBSY ("text file busy"), and it also had to reconcile decision D08. The verifier rejected it. One of seven acceptance criteria was unmet: the diff may touch only athena-testutil, the manifests, Cargo.lock, six listed test files and four docs files. One major finding was raised: most call sites were only switched to write_executable, and their stand-in runs are not retried, so the flake can still happen there. The cited sites are xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs. The first two are outside the allowed file list. No failed check is named. The work seems to have gone outside its scope and still left the flake unfixed.
cause: The allowed file list was written before anyone listed the places that actually spawn stand-in scripts. The goal (stop ETXTBSY everywhere) needed edits in xtask and athena-core, which the scope criterion forbids, so the goal and the scope could not both be met. Nothing compared the diff's file list with the allowed set while the producer worked, and nothing compared the reading's file list with the real call sites when the reading was accepted. The producer chose a partial, in-scope change, and only the final verifier saw the mismatch.
prevention: Add a check that runs before the verifier and on the producer's finished diff. It compares the changed file list with the allowed deliverables from the accepted reading and reports any extra files to the producer so it can revert them or report a blocker. For a helper-introduction job, the reading should also list every call site found by searching the code, and the allowed set must include those files. If the list does not fit one job, the reading must say so and split the work.
proposed_request: Stop the ETXTBSY ("text file busy") flake when tests and checks write and then run stand-in executable scripts. Outcome: every place that writes a stand-in script and then runs it goes through one shared helper in crates/athena-testutil that either avoids the race or retries the run on ETXTBSY. First search the whole repo (xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/*, and any others) for stand-in script writes, and list every call site in the plan. All listed call sites are in scope, including the production-side files, but only for switching to the helper. Production behavior must not change otherwise. Acceptance: (1) the helper exists in athena-testutil with a test that proves an ETXTBSY on the first run is retried and succeeds; (2) no call site in the repo writes a stand-in script and runs it without the helper (show the search that proves it); (3) reconcile docs/decisions.md D08 with an amending entry and a link in docs/decision-links.toml; (4) add a CHANGELOG.md entry; (5) the diff touches only the helper crate, the manifests and Cargo.lock, the call-site files found in the search, docs/architecture.md, docs/decisions.md, docs/decision-links.toml and CHANGELOG.md. athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unchanged; (6) cargo test --locked passes.
